title: Builder BLD-303: Theme lens

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-303.

detail:
B3 Lenses, pass BLD-303 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-303). Theme lens. Scope: components/builder/theme. Build: Hover a theme: swap the static theme stylesheet and data-theme on the canvas; prefetch on hover. Unpinned sections show the theme's default variant; commit is one undo step. Done when: Switching makes no document request once cached; Pinned variants never change on switch. Gates: check:theme-conformance, audit:themes render matrix, check:build-budget and check:shell-weight, Pass probes, check:contrast, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-108. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Theme lens (components/builder/theme, lib/builder/theme-lens.ts): a Theme button in the top bar (also in the command bar) opens a side sheet of theme cards; the card under the pointer or focus is worn by the canvas at once through the live resolver (lensStyle: the tried theme with its own fonts, else the draft's theme over the live style), the contract skin module is prefetched on hover and the swap is one React commit, so once cached no request is made and the document never leaves memory. Picking a card is one edit (commitTheme: draft theme, stored styles back to the theme's own, grid placements reset, every block's props kept), so one undo step takes it back; the live site changes only on publish. Pinned layouts (variantSet, BLD-203) never change on a switch and unpinned ones follow the new theme's presentation default, proven over every role, pinned and free, across every theme pair. Also fixes the builder canvas ignoring the draft's theme (it wore the live site style only).
